# BTicino C300X Integration v1.3.0

This release focuses on easier setup, clearer media diagnostics, ready-made
automations and a better C300X display dashboard experience.

It updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `1.3.0`.

## Highlights

- Updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `1.3.0`.
- Adds guided **Media readiness** repairs for common media setup problems:
  agent reachability, media-user/routing setup, forwarding, firewall and
  callback URL checks.
- Adds bundled automation blueprints for:
  - doorbell notifications,
  - Ring Call notifications,
  - Ring Capture,
  - Ring Capture with local Wyoming transcription,
  - strict phrase decisions with optional unlock.
- Improves the C300X display dashboard:
  - dynamic home page is the default for new installs,
  - selected entities keep the configured order,
  - each dashboard entity can have its own display name and secondary text,
  - Alarm page quick action is selectable,
  - weather display includes richer information when available.
- Improves media stability around Ring Call and on-demand RTSP startup/recovery.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload the browser or clear the Home Assistant app/WebView cache if a
  dashboard still shows old card behavior.
- If you use C300X display pages, update the native C300X device agent from
  Home Assistant so active display patches can be refreshed.
